description: This PHP class 'Analyzer' in the Drupal views module manages view analysis plugins, providing methods to analyze views, format messages, and handle analysis results with support for multiple message types.

classes.name: Analyzer
classes.description: A plugin manager class for analyzing Drupal views, capable of generating analysis messages and formatting results.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Analyzer with a module handler that invokes the 'views_analyze' hook.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Analyzes a given view and returns an array of messages organized by status.

methods.name: formatMessages
methods.description: Formats an array of messages into HTML output, grouping by message type.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Creates a standardized message array with message text and type.
